title: hunch doctor exits 1 on every pre-publish release commit because the exact pins are unpublished; tests must not assert doctor exit 0 in the source checkout
observation: doctor checks each committed exact pin (.windsurf/hooks.json, plugin/.mcp.json) against npm with publishedStatus and prints 'ERROR <file>: pins Hunch <v>, which npm cannot serve (ETARGET)' with exit 1 when the pinned version is not on npm. A release commit bumps those pins to the version being released BEFORE the tag publishes it, so doctor exits 1 on that commit by design, in PR CI and in the tag-push release gate alike. test/updatecheck.test.ts 'a spawned source-checkout CLI neither checks nor writes a user cache' (added by #227, merged after 1.33.0 published) asserted doctor exit 0 and failed the 1.34.0 release PR on both Node 22 and 24. Fixed by asserting only that the CLI ran and wrote no user cache. Any future test that spawns doctor in the repository must tolerate a non-zero status or stub publishedStatus.
evidence: CI run 34842722646 ci(22)/ci(24): '✖ a spawned source-checkout CLI neither checks nor writes a user cache' → AssertionError 1 !== 0; stdout: 'ERROR .windsurf/hooks.json: pins Hunch 1.34.0, which npm cannot serve (ETARGET)'
src/cli/index.ts:6336-6341 loop over integrations.pins → process.exitCode = 1 when publishedStatus(pin.version) === 'unpublished'
test/updatecheck.test.ts arrived in 592c56e (#227), after v1.33.0 was tagged, so 1.34.0 is the first release commit it gated
fixed in 7c5c455 (test(updatecheck): do not tie the source-checkout cache test to doctor's exit status)
